ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Emojis help us to be super-quick and efficient when responding. Yet, this also raises a question: is this actually a good thing? This kind of rapid response is closely linked to the development of the smartphone. Our communication is now so directly influenced by technology that the two cannot be separated. Technology has increased our efficiency and productivity, but it is a double-edged sword. We may end up less human than we ever wanted. As we adapt to rapidity and hyper-productivity, our conversation may become like fast food, and we may lose the ability to produce and enjoy slow talk. Before the arrival of the smartphone, we were able to wait a couple of days for an answer to an email, and for urgent matters, we made a call. We knew the division between these two forms of communication. 10 In the smartphone era, we cannot and do not wait. 11 We expect an immediate answer for everything.

det.tip: double-edged sword(양날의 검): 좋은 면과 나쁜 면이 공존함을 비유. reliable tool(신뢰할 수 있는 도구)은 긍정적 의미만 내포.
